applicability: Standard two-sample mean-comparison sample-size calculation (normal approximation) from declared effect size, variance, significance and power
assumptions: approximately normally distributed outcome in both groups
equal variance and equal sample size assumed in both groups
the declared standard deviation is a reasonable prior estimate
excluded: non-normal or rank-based test sample-size formulas
pilot-study validation of the assumed standard deviation
uncertainty: Standard textbook experimental-design statistics; hand-verified before use (sigma=5, delta=2, alpha=0.05, power=0.8 -> z_alpha/2=1.959964, z_beta=0.841621, n=98.11).
limits_policy: Required sample size exceeding the declared budget is flagged rather than silently truncated.
